creator: Operator
scope: Six genuine new back/north and side/east views for the existing field recorder, sealed evidence case and survey tag; original source masters only. No provider assets copied.
ownerDirection: gate size variants too right and any other things we need like journal and such and converting into game world
visualReview: Reviewed the existing front masters and each generated output. Recorder rear changes its front controls to vents and battery hatch; case rear uses hinges instead of front latches and handle; tag rear has plain reverse material. East views expose narrower end/edge silhouettes with physical depth.
orientationLimitations: Art uses the existing masters' high camera with a partly front-facing projection rather than strict top-down. East silhouettes are intentionally narrower; the converter must preserve alpha and apply consistent tile sizing. West may use RimWorld's native east mirroring, which swaps asymmetric recorder/case details. In-game scale and readability remain unobserved; no game was launched.
